blocks.text: Take Your Tablet to the Next Level: Using your iPad makes it easy to work from anywhere, but to be truly productive, you need a keyboard with all the right functions. The Messenger Folio 2 has laptop-style keys and a durable case with a tab for Apple Pencil. It also has high-end features like special function keys, space-efficient design, and polished, professional look that make this keyboard case combo a stand-out.

items.label: Space Efficient, Standing Design
items.value: The Messenger Folio 2 case holds your iPad securely upright so you don’t need extra surface space to accommodate a kickstand. Your iPad locks into a slot on the keyboard and fits neatly into the top of the case, making it easy to use in tight spaces, like an airplane tray.

items.label: Laptop-style Keys
items.value: No more cramped typing and misspelled words. Spacious laptop-style keys with clean precise keystrokes make typing fast and easy.

items.label: Detachable Keyboard and Holder for Apple Pencil
items.value: The keyboard and case detach to accommodate different uses and environments. The tab for Apple Pencil keeps it, or any other stylus, close-at-hand for when inspiration strikes.

items.label: Highlighted Function Keys
items.value: The row of highlighted function keys at the top of the keyboard increases your speed and efficiency. Shortcut keys like Apps Running, Keyboard Hide/Show, Search, Pairing, Play, Next Play, Volume Control and more means you don’t have to hunt and scroll for options.

items.label: On-the-Go Efficiency
items.value: Messenger Folio 2 is easy to use when you’re on-the-go with instant pairing and type-C charging—the latest, most convenient way to charge. The magnetic closure holds the case securely closed while it’s in your bag. The Messenger Folio 2 case also has the polished look and comfortable feel of more expensively priced, luxury tablet accessories.
